prompt:
A single small game icon, painted in a rustic 1990s hand-painted trading-card style (gouache and ink, muted antique colours, matte, slightly worn), with a bold, simple silhouette that still reads at 16 pixels. Centred with generous empty margin, on a fully transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no badge or circle behind it, no drop shadow.

Subject: The Offering coin: a single antique silver Greek drachma seen perfectly straight-on, filling the frame, worn and tarnished with a raised rim, small nicks and scratches, dark grime in the recesses and soft rubbed highlights, its face mostly smooth with a faint, low-relief skull wreathed in laurel struck in the centre. Matte, painted like the weathered frames of an old trading card; no shine, no text, no letters, no numbers.
